verdict.rationale: Factory documents `droid exec` as its headless execution mode. It runs as a one-shot command that completes a task and exits, is explicitly aimed at CI/CD pipelines and shell scripts, supports structured input and output formats, and uses tiered autonomy so operations can run without manual confirmation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an agent headlessly inside CI/CD pipelines and shell scripts

citations.quote: Droid Exec is Factory's headless execution mode designed for automation workflows. Unlike the interactive CLI, `droid exec` runs as a one-shot command that completes a task and exits, making it ideal for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and batch processing.
droid exec runs in scripts and CI/CD pipelines with structured input and output formats.
Droid exec uses tiered autonomy to control what operations can run without manual confirmation.
